description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the ThingDefinition interface, providing methods for creating and parsing definitions, and exposing properties like namespace, name, and version.

classes.name: ImmutableThingDefinition
classes.description: An immutable class implementing ThingDefinition, representing a specific, unchangeable definition of a 'thing' with associated namespace, name, and version.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of ImmutableThingDefinition with specified namespace, name, and version.

methods.name: ofParsed
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence representation of a ThingDefinition identifier and returns an ImmutableThingDefinition instance.
